result.rationale: The diff removes SiteSetting.embed_category (site_settings.yml, server.en.yml, topic.rb) and changes TopicEmbed.import to `category: eh.try(:category_id)`, which is nil when no EmbeddableHost row matches the URL's host, causing imported topics to fall back to uncategorized. This is a verifiable behavioral regression from the removed setting's guaranteed default category.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` from `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?(@embed_url)` to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(@embed_url)` (lib/topic_retriever.rb), so feed-polled imports (which use TopicRetriever in the existing design) already required the feed/entry host to be in the allowlist before this PR; registering the host as “embeddable” is not a new requirement and was already equivalent in terms of opening embedding access. Also, `EmbeddableHost` rows always have a non-null `category_id` (migration + controller default to uncategorized), so `eh.try(:category_id)` is only nil when there is no matching row—an input that upstream host validation should reject, not a demonstrated regression in the diff.
